summary: Sprint 2 frontend-only validation: login via 'Ouvrir le compte test (Thomas)', PWA service worker, onboarding persistence, InspirationScreen dock (5 piliers + Boutique), CRM push button in Croissance, sidebar non-regression and multi-route load. 6/7 test scenarios PASS; CRM sync not testable (empty pipeline).
critical_code_review_comments: InspirationScreen dock reveals only after ~3.1s delay; consider a data attribute or aria-live so E2E tests can wait deterministically instead of a hard timeout.
CRM sync flow could not be validated end-to-end because the pipeline is empty in the Thomas test account; recommend seeding at least one lead in dev seed data for automated regression.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable scenarios (6/6 pass, 1 not testable)

test_credentials: Compte test Thomas via bouton 'Ouvrir le compte test (Thomas)' (thomas@zayado.fr, magic-link dev)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is via green button on /login (no email input). InspirationScreen appears on load and its dock (data-testid=insp-dock) becomes visible only after ~3s (SEQUENCE delay 3.1s); wait 4-6s before asserting dock content. Dock item testids follow pattern insp-dock-<label lowercased with '-'> (e.g., insp-dock-espace-de-travail, insp-dock-croissance). Onboarding persistence uses localStorage keys prefixed 'zayado_onboarding_seen_<path>'. Pipeline in Croissance is empty in the Thomas seed data so 'lead-crm-<id>' button is present in code but not renderable; to test the CRM push flow, either seed a lead first or hit backend /api/growth/leads/{id}/push-crm directly. profile-moi is inside DropdownMenu opened by data-testid=header-profile-btn.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no blocking issues found. Verified: (1) service worker registered (getRegistrations().length=1, /service-worker.js HTTP 200); (2) After closing Cockpit onboarding modal and navigating away and back to /, the modal did NOT reappear (persistence via localStorage OK); (3) InspirationScreen dock displays exactly Cockpit / Vision / Croissance / Espace de travail / DAF IA / Boutique, with NO 'CRM', 'Growth Agent', 'Mon énergie' or 'Vision Board' labels present; clicking Croissance navigates to /croissance; code path for 'Espace de travail' maps to /travail (verified in InspirationScreen.jsx line 22); (4) Sidebar exposes all 5 pillar testids side-cockpit/side-vision/side-croissance/side-travail/side-dafia; profile-moi is reachable via header-profile-btn dropdown; (5) Routes /, /croissance, /travail, /vision-board, /pilotage all load with no page errors and non-empty body. CRM 'push-crm' button (data-testid lead-crm-<id>) could not be exercised because the Kanban pipeline is empty for the Thomas account — reported as NOT_TESTABLE, not a failure.
